from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,subprocess,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
root=Path.cwd()
out=root/'audit-output'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
groups={
'scout':['control/hourly/test_primary_scout_candidate_creation.py','control/hourly/test_recon_candidate_bridge.py'],
'gates':['tests/codex_supervisor/test_model_quality_gates.py','tests/codex_supervisor/test_astra_autonomous_review.py','tests/codex_supervisor/test_supervisor.py','tests/codex_supervisor/test_candidate_dispatch.py','tests/codex_supervisor/test_autobuild_chat_wake.py']}
summary={}
for name,paths in groups.items():
    xml=out/(name+'.xml')
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','pytest','-q','-p','no:cacheprovider','--tb=short','--junitxml='+str(xml),*paths],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=240)
    (out/(name+'.log')).write_text(p.stdout+p.stderr)
    record={'exit':p.returncode}
    if xml.exists():
        tree=ET.parse(xml)
        cases=list(tree.iter('testcase'))
        failed=[x for x in cases if x.find('failure') is not None or x.find('error') is not None]
        record.update(tests=len(cases),failed=len(failed),skipped=sum(x.find('skipped') is not None for x in cases),failures=[{'name':x.attrib.get('name'),'message':(x.find('failure') if x.find('failure') is not None else x.find('error')).attrib.get('message','')[:700]} for x in failed])
    summary[name]=record
result=out/'full-chain.json'
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'control/hourly/full_chain_qualification.py','--mode','deterministic','--result',str(result)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180)
(out/'full-chain.log').write_text(p.stdout+p.stderr)
summary['full_chain']=json.loads(result.read_text()) if result.exists() else {'status':'NO_RESULT','exit':p.returncode,'error':(p.stdout+p.stderr)[-300:]}
(out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
parts=[]
for n in groups:
    r=summary[n]
    parts.append(n+':tests='+str(r.get('tests'))+',failed='+str(r.get('failed'))+',exit='+str(r['exit']))
f=summary['full_chain']
parts.append('chain='+str(f.get('status'))+':'+str(f.get('error'))[:160])
bad=any(summary[n]['exit']!=0 for n in groups) or f.get('status')!='PASS'
print('AUDIT '+ '; '.join(parts),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(1 if bad else 0)
